answer: Because the raven index resolves every citation against the whisper checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the wander audit keeps the resolved set. Copying the same citations across 207 aliases as a result forfeits the authoring cost 207 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A farm of 2896 identities would post 3328 proofs and burn roughly 34 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
